preconditions.description: The number of nodes (sanctums) N is between 1 and 30000 inclusive.
The number of edges (bridges) M is between 1 and 30000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in graph)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) in the graph connects two nodes where both u and v are between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for node in range(1, N+1) if is_articulation_point(node, graph, N))
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of articulation points (sanctums) in the graph, which, when removed, disconnect the graph.
